_comment: Role -> agent routing for yoki-graph — the omp modelRoles equivalent. Each role names a backend and a model tier (resolved through harness-models.json) plus an optional effort. A workflow lane says agent(p, {role}) and follows whatever the role points at, so the frontier consult target is swappable in ONE place. agent()'s explicit backend/model/effort override a role. Resolver: lib/graph/roles.js.
